messages:
deploy-bot: release r-2026.03.21 deployed to canary -> all canaries healthy. initiating post-deploy smoke checks across regions. change window until 03:30 UTC.

tyler: starting verification pass. I'll watch synths + gateway metrics. tagging @infra-oncall for visibility.

anna: running synthetic embed bench now (batch of 200 tiny prompts) against eu1/us-west.

anna: eu1 synth summary: success 198/200, embed_p95=325ms, embed_p50=95ms, spike concentrated at ~15:41 UTC.

margaret: us-west looks clean: embed_p95=168ms. no gateway errors.

sanjay: saw a short gateway 502 on eu1 at 15:41 that coincides with synth spikes. correlating with LB logs. link: https://logs.redwood/requests/trace/eu1-502-15-41

isabel: quick check of model workers: some warmstarts around that window; prefill rate went up 30% for a few nodes. might be correlated.

tyler: ok we have a region-localized p95 tail. I prefer to divert eu traffic back to r-previous for a short mitigation rather than full rollback. proposal: traffic-split eu -> 0% new (redirect to redwood-v2-q7@2026-03-10) for 20m while we investigate. keep us-west on new variant.

anna: +1 from infra side; can execute region-only traffic diversion. running quick impact calc: estimated increased latency for eu users ~+10ms but stable.

margaret: add to release_notes: "eu1 transient embed p95 tail observed during ramp; traffic temporarily diverted to previous variant for mitigation; follow-up investigation in progress."

sanjay: rollback criteria for full rollback if divert doesn't reduce embed_p95 below 220ms within 10m or if error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m. otherwise continue investigation.

deploy-bot: action: create ticket postdeploy-eu-diversion-5371234567, owners: tyler/anna/sanjay; executing traffic change: eu routing -> redwood-v2-q7@2026-03-10 for cluster eu1.

deploy-bot: traffic change applied. eu1: new_variant_traffic=0%, previous_variant_traffic=100% (region-only).

anna: re-running synths against eu1 now.

anna: eu1 synth after diversion: success 200/200, embed_p95=172ms, no gateway errors in last 5m.

tyler: that's good. hold diversion for 20m and capture full telemetry. do root-cause triage in parallel (warmstart patterns + lb jitter).

isabel: I'll collect node prefill traces and kv_cache warmup logs and upload to the ticket.

margaret: also adding a quick dashboard tile for eu1 embed_p95 and gateway 5xx to the release card.

sanjay: monitoring alert set: if eu1 embed_p95 > 240ms for two consecutive 5m windows, we escalate to full rollback.

tyler: once diversion window completes and metrics stable, we'll plan a controlled reintroduce (10% bump every 5m) with the synthetic monitor on. ping :rocket: when ready to reintroduce.

deploy-bot: note recorded in changelog: r-2026.03.21 partial-region-diversion enacted 5371234567. follow-up ticket: https://tickets.redwood/5371234567

tyler: thanks everyone — short updates only in this thread. closing loop once reintroduce complete.
